prompt:
Hand-painted stylised texture for a bright, high-fantasy voxel game. Painterly: soft brush shapes, chunky readable forms, detail gathered in clumps, never photographic and never noisy. One light from the top left: each shape has a highlight on its top-left edge and shade on its bottom-right edge. Shadows lean cool blue-purple, highlights lean warm; colours are rich and saturated. Seen flat and straight on, orthographic, no perspective, evenly lit across the whole frame, no vignette. The material fills the frame edge to edge as a seamless tileable texture. No border, no text, no logo, no objects other than the material. An original look, not copied from any existing game.

Keep this stone texture exactly as it is, same rock, same light, same framing, and set copper ore into it: about six to eight clusters of jewel-like warm orange copper nuggets with cut facets, bright gold rims on their top-left edges, a dark outline where they meet the rock, and a soft shadow below and to the right. The copper glows a little in its own colour. The result is still a seamless tileable texture.
